summary: Smoke test of the re-imported GiftsDates app with Stripe. Backend: 31/31 pytest passed across test_reimport_smoke_stripe.py, test_stripe_checkout.py and test_smoke_auth.py. These cover health, register/login/me, duplicate and wrong-password handling, admin login, the main page endpoints, checkout for every package type (coins, custom, premium, premium_lite, VIP subscription, unknown package rejected with 400, custom amount below the minimum rejected), payment status, and the webhook rejecting a bad signature. Frontend: the landing page loads with the original logo and dark luxury styling. Admin login goes to /browse, and /admin opens with all its tabs. The test user's /browse, /profile, /dates and /wallet pages load with no page errors. Wallet > Top up shows 5 coin packages plus a custom amount. Clicking Small Talk ($9.99) redirected to checkout.stripe.com (sandbox, managed payments/Link). I paid with 4242 4242 4242 4242 and a US billing address. Stripe returned to /payment/success?session_id=..., which showed 'Payment successful', and the header coin count went from 0 to 100. GET /api/payments/status/{sid} returns completed/paid. Calling it again does not credit coins twice (stays at 100).
action_items: /app/memory/test_credentials.md has only the header comments and no credentials. Add admin giftsdates@gmail.com / Admin@12345 and testuser@giftsdates.com / Test@12345.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} needs no auth. Anyone with a session id can trigger fulfillment. It credits the right user and is idempotent, so the risk is low, but consider requiring auth or checking the owner.
server.py is more than 5000 lines. Consider splitting payments, auth and admin into routers (not urgent).

Coins are only credited when the user returns to /payment/success or when the Stripe webhook arrives. Check that STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set for production; otherwise a user who closes the tab before the redirect only gets coins via the webhook.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_stripe_checkout.py (stale admin password Admin@GD24! -> Admin@12345, removed hardcoded default URL)
seed_data_creation: One real sandbox payment for testuser@giftsdates.com (Small Talk, now 100 coins). Several initiated-but-unpaid checkout sessions. test_*@example.com users created by the register test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To fill Stripe Checkout in Playwright: the Card option's accordion button is not visible, so mouse-click the bounding box of #payment-method-label-card. Then fill #cardNumber/#cardExpiry/#cardCvc/#billingName, select #billingCountry US, fill #billingAddressLine1 and press Escape to close the Google autocomplete, fill #billingLocality/#billingPostalCode, select #billingAdministrativeArea, fill #phoneNumber (Link requires it), and click [data-testid=hosted-payment-submit-button]. Many old test files in /app/backend/tests use old seeds and passwords.
